text:
Nina (CSM): Pre-cutover check for Harborline private deploy tomorrow 08:30 PT — focus: VPC peering vs TGW decision, cross-account IAM role, KMS CMK ownership, S3 audit-log lifecycle and immutability. Need heads-up items from Harborline.

Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll bring two network patterns and a checklist for security groups, endpoints, and route propagation. If they use TGW we need to confirm route table propagation and whether routing is centralized.

Sofia (Infra Eng): For KMS: if they want customer-managed CMK, we require a key policy that allows our service principal and the assume-role. We can support 30/90 day rotation cadences; automation via our rotation-lambda is recommended. Also clarify if S3 SSE-KMS should use the same CMK as CloudTrail.

Eli (Harborline): We'll prefer separate CMKs for logs and data. We also need a 365-day retention on audit logs with WORM/Compliance mode for a subset. Can Redwood write to buckets with Object Lock enabled?

Sofia (Infra Eng): Yes, provided Harborline owns the bucket and grants PutObject and PutObjectRetention permissions. Object Lock must be enabled at bucket creation. Share bucket ARN and confirm creation prior to cutover.

Nina (CSM): Action items before call: Eli send AWS account ID + bucket ARN + preferred role name; Omar attach network diagrams to the invite; Sofia post a minimal key-policy snippet and rotation options. I'll update the invite and include a cutover checklist and renewal-risk note (30-day pilot SLO checkpoints).

onboard-bot: Runbook snapshot uploaded: https://redwood.example/onboarding/private-vpc/latest (read-only).

Omar (Solutions Eng): adding materials now. See you all tomorrow.

Nina (CSM): Thanks — will do a quick pre-validation of policies if Harborline posts ARNs early.
